desc: Analyze the operation: each step applies a displacement vector where pieces left of i move +1, right of i move -1, and at i move 0. The relative order is preserved, so match sorted a to sorted b (with repetitions allowed from target set S).

Determine the necessary and sufficient condition for a given matching b to be reachable: likely that the sequence d_j = b_j - a_j must be "unimodal" or satisfy that the prefix sums of d are bounded, or equivalently, that b can be obtained by a sequence of such moves.
Investigate the counterexample a=[1,2,10], b=[1,5,10]: BFS confirms min ops = 3, matching the binary search formula min over D of max |a_j - b_j|.
Validate the solution on sample inputs and additional edge cases (minimal N, impossible cases, large N) to ensure correctness and performance.
Optimize the solution if needed, ensuring O(N log N) or O(N) per test case with total N ≤ 10^6.
